title: Lavender Taffeta Silk Gota Work Anarkali Suit Set with Organza Dupatta
description:
A dreamy lavender Anarkali suit set in rich taffeta silk with shimmering gota lace – handcrafted in Jaipur by Bahe Kurtiz.

The sleeveless Anarkali has an elegant square neckline edged with silver gota, a fitted bodice and a full, flowing flare that swirls beautifully with every step. The hem is finished with layered rows of gota lace for a festive Rajasthani touch. It comes with matching pants and a sheer organza dupatta with delicate gold butis and a gota border.

• Anarkali: taffeta silk, square neck with gota, sleeveless, full flare, layered gota lace hem, ankle length
• Pant: matching lavender, comfortable fit
• Dupatta: organza with gold buti and gota lace border
• Light sheen that looks beautiful in photos and evening light
• Perfect for sangeet, mehendi, wedding guest looks, Diwali, Karwa Chauth and festive parties

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth, away from moisture, to keep the gota bright. Steam or iron on low heat on the reverse side.
